plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Plugin for multi-agent PR code review workflow

plugins.name: rules-on-create
plugins.description: Plugin that makes path-based rules in .claude/rules/ and CLAUDE.md apply on file creation (Write), not only on Read

plugins.name: auto-simplify-hook
plugins.description: Stop hook that blocks completion when there are 10+ changed lines and /simplify has not been run

plugins.name: package-manager-enforcer
plugins.description: Plugin that blocks mismatched package manager commands by detecting the correct package manager from package.json packageManager field or lock files

plugins.name: plan-rule-review
plugins.description: PreToolUse(ExitPlanMode) hook that reviews the plan for compliance with project rules (CLAUDE.md / .claude/rules/) before allowing exit

plugins.name: plan-rubocop-review
plugins.description: PreToolUse(ExitPlanMode) hook that validates Ruby code blocks in the plan with RuboCop (--stdin) before allowing exit

plugins.name: plan-archive
plugins.description: Stop hook that moves plan files older than 30 days (by mtime) into an archived/ subdirectory, resolving the plans directory from the transcript's planFilePath and prefixing each filename with its last-modified timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM)

plugins.name: compact-handoff
plugins.description: SessionStart(compact) hook that extracts the raw log segment dropped by compaction and has `claude -p` summarize only the gaps the standard compaction summary tends to miss (rejected alternatives, unexecuted commitments, constraints), injecting the result as additionalContext

plugins.name: plan-workflow
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that injects Plan mode operating rules (requirement interview, delegating implementation to Agents, model routing) when permission_mode is plan, plus a PermissionRequest(ExitPlanMode) hook that resolves the plan file from the transcript and opens it in the browser with `mo` (a Markdown viewer) right before the approval dialog appears, without affecting the approval decision

plugins.name: plan-visualize
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that injects plan visualization rules (Mermaid diagrams and tables) as additionalContext when permission_mode is plan, encouraging plans to express flows, structures, and comparisons visually
